newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle light at $66, off $1- USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle light at $66, off $1- USDA.

text.p: Trade was near a standstill in the Panhandle area Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers.

Sales reported on 1,100 head slaughter steers and 100 heifers; 25,500 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 14,900 head formulated and 200 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1200 lbs 66.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1100 lbs 66.00.
Wk to Date - 25,500 Week Ago - 100 Year Ago - 11,900
